title: Ward Duty (composed)
description: Generated by 08-tools/build-schemas.ts from the raw schema plus registered extensions. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with: node 08-tools/build-schemas.ts
x-docIdRule: The document id is {date}_{wardId}, where date is the IST day as YYYY-MM-DD. The server computes the date. The client must not, because a phone in the wrong timezone would read the wrong day's duty.
x-writes: platform functions: startShift creates the row as in_progress, markWardDone flips it to completed
userapp: NONE. The citizen app's direct write is removed. CHG-0011.
x-reads: userapp: via getWardDutyStatus, for their own ward only
adminpanel: for the wards in their live staff scope

wardId.description: The ward this row is about.

date.description: The IST day as YYYY-MM-DD. The server's day, not the client's.

isDutyOver.description: The same fact as status, kept as a boolean because the user app's UI reads it as a boolean. status = completed is the source. isDutyOver mirrors it. They must never disagree.

vanId.description: The van that is serving this ward. Optional, because the office may close the duty without a van.

tripId.description: The trip that served this ward. Optional.
